summary: v22 Document Studio unification + async compose + notifications: 20/20 backend pytest tests PASSED. Async compose (POST /docstudio/compose-async → poll /compose-jobs/{id} → done → GET document) works end-to-end with real data; Claude narrative AI blocks populated (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY set). Sync compose/company-snapshot for master_id mc_d06d23d431d7 returns 200 with AI narrative. All layout endpoints (add/delete block, page-break, brand-overlay set+clear, color-override) return 200. Export PDF & PPTX return 200 with correct content-types. Engine regressions all green (signals=66050, opportunities=160, iberinform real=24992, fragmentation, ratios, watchlist, providers/health). Auth negatives return 401/403. UI: single 'Document Intelligence Studio' page shows 5 sub-tabs (Generar/Documentos/Plantillas/Constructor/Marcas), notifications bell shows 4 'Documento listo: ...' entries with unread badge, legacy /documents /brands /template-builder redirect to /doc-studio, 13 launchable doc-type buttons present in Generar, launching 'Generar informe' shows toast with ETA ('generando en segundo plano (~1 s). Te avisaremos al terminar.'), and after completion a new notification appears in the bell. Opening a document reveals the editor with data-testid='document-editor', Maximize button (data-testid='maximize-toggle'), Personalizar (brand-toggle), Guardar/PDF/PPTX buttons, per-section 'Añadir módulo' (Texto/KPI/Idea/Tabla/Separador/Salto de página) and delete-section/delete-block controls. 0 console errors across doc-studio, editor, opportunities, signals, data-quality, data-providers.

minor.issue: GET occasionally times out (>15s) while the compose worker is actively running an LLM call — event loop appears blocked during Claude generation. Job still completes and status becomes 'done'; polling with retry/longer timeout succeeds. Not a v22 blocker (compose worker itself works), but suggests some sync work (or blocking mongo call) inside the compose path.

verified_functionality.auth_negatives: docstudio/documents (no JWT) → 401/403. signal-intelligence/stats/view (no JWT) → 401/403. investment-intelligence/fragmentation (no X-API-Key) → 401/403.

Memo (Investment Memo), Benchmark, Aprox. valor, Valoración avanzada, Análisis estratégico, Comparativo, Perfil sucesión, Ranking, Fragmentación, Roll-up, Sectorial (Generar informe). Oportunidades + 'Generar desde plantilla' also present.

verified_functionality.ui_editor_controls: Opening a document renders data-testid='document-editor' with Maximize (data-testid='maximize-toggle'), Personalizar (data-testid='brand-toggle'), Guardar, PDF, PPTX buttons + per-section 'Añadir módulo' (Texto/KPI/Idea/Tabla/Separador/Salto de página), delete-section-* and delete-<block_id> controls, and 'Añadir sección'.

action_items: OPTIONAL/PERF: investigate why GET /docstudio/compose-jobs/{id} occasionally blocks >15s while the compose worker is executing an LLM call. Likely something in the compose path (or a mongo call) is not fully async, blocking the FastAPI event loop for the duration of the Claude request (~20s). Not a functional blocker — the async flow completes correctly and the frontend polls with longer timeouts.
critical_code_review_comments: docstudio/routes.py is now 1333 lines — recommend splitting into layout/compose/export/notifications sub-routers (>700 line guideline).

GET /docstudio/documents/{id} returns the doc under a top-level 'document' key (not the doc itself) — inconsistent with list endpoint; ensure clients (and any new integrations) handle both shapes. Frontend already does.
compose_worker.enqueue_compose + _run_compose_job correctly persist job status, notify user, and set document_id — clean design.
estimate_ms falls back to overall average and finally to None (never fabricated) — good.
All layout & notification endpoints correctly gated by get_current_user (JWT).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (0 console errors, all v22 UI features present and clickable)
